purpose: Repair the project-local Python dependency gate for the existing jsonschema Gateway dependency and verify the P0 offline Python suite.
allowed_operations: install resolved jsonschema wheels and transitive wheels into E:/project/OpenClaw_VideoFactory/.venv only
download dependency wheels only under E:/Claude_allow/Download
record package version, source, SHA-256, and license
run local Schema and P0 Python tests
prohibited_actions: modify Feishu Binding, Agent, Cron, OAuth, model, or Gateway lifecycle
connect to Feishu or OpenClaw RPC
send a real message, attachment, or card
commit, push, tag, change PROJECT_STATUS.yaml, or create P0_READY
rollback: Uninstall only the packages installed by this change from the project-local .venv; no external runtime state is modified.
secrets: The dependency report records package metadata and hashes only. No credentials, tokens, raw Feishu identifiers, or configuration content are read or recorded.
